summary: thesis get/search and the corpus/analytics commands use a hand-authored internal/dspace HTML client for full Dublin Core extraction.
reason: Shodhganga exposes no OAI/REST/OpenSearch API; the generated html_extract 'page' mode only captured the item title and nav links, not the DC.* meta tags (researcher, guide, university, keywords). internal/dspace parses those into typed records, and thesis_get.go/thesis_search.go were rewritten to use it. The university 'list' endpoint (/community-list, a 900+-university mega-page that hangs) was removed from the spec.
validated_outcome: shipcheck 7/7 PASS, scorecard 88/100 Grade A, full live dogfood 90/90 at 120s timeout, internal/dspace unit tests pass.
